description: Near-term Enyo NNUE experiment: search-aware mateguard training from the existing Enyo/Berserk-derived net, using broad init-net distillation plus weighted engine-search targets.
hypothesis: The previous SF-binpack float-head runs had broad signal but failed mate/endgame tails. Weight mate-like search targets while distilling broad positions to the current net, so any exported movement must improve engine-search behavior without broad drift.
gates: net-diff must show intentional exported movement
static validation must not clearly regress sign/MAE
search/move gate must improve capped gap or top-move behavior without mate-like regression
failure-suite replay must not introduce an unacceptable tail
SPRT only if cheap gates are clean

validation.next: run committed search-aware mateguard preflight; stop before SPRT unless net-diff, search gate, and failure-suite are clean
